items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: we'd go by where he was playing with Andy Kirk's wife, Mary, who was a very good pianist

ctx.x: Do you remember when you first met Charlie Parker?

When we were working at Wehnwood Beach we'd go by where he was playing with Andy Kirk's wife, Mary, who was a very good pianist, but she had the old style... and Charlie Parker was playing just the way he did when he was in New York and it sounded funny to the boys. They'd say, "I don't know what that alto player's playing." "He sounds good but I don't know what he's doing." The two combinations together were really funny.
I asked you this before, but did the people in general in Kansas City understand what Charlie was doing?
